title: Articles Feature — public articles with instructor authoring, markdown editor, admin featured control, and landing-page integration
task: Add an Articles tab in the landing-page navbar; a featured-articles control in /admin to select articles shown on the landing page; instructor-authored articles publicly viewable; advanced markdown editor with preview-before-publish; each article has image, title, description, auto reading-time from char count, and slug; backend + frontend for list/detail pages with search.

apiContract.ArticleRequest: { title:string(req), description:string, content:string(req markdown), coverImageUrl:string, category:string, published:boolean }
apiContract.ArticleResponse: { id, title, slug, description, content, coverImageUrl, readingTimeMinutes, published, authorUserId, authorName, category, createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt }
apiContract.ArticleSummaryResponse: { id, title, slug, description, coverImageUrl, readingTimeMinutes, authorName, category, published, publishedAt }
endpoints: GET /api/articles/mine -> List<ArticleResponse> (own incl drafts; ADMIN sees all) [INSTRUCTOR|ADMIN]
GET /api/articles/id/{id} -> ArticleResponse (owner or ADMIN, for editing) [INSTRUCTOR|ADMIN]
apiContract.slug: auto-generated from title, unicode-aware (supports Arabic), unique (append -2,-3 on collision); client slug ignored

stories.title: Backend: Article entity, repository, DTOs, MapStruct mapper, Flyway migration V14
acceptanceCriteria: Article.java exists at backend/src/main/java/com/itqan/edu/features/articles/Article.java as a JPA @Entity(@Table name=articles) with Lombok @Data/@Builder/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor

Article has fields: Long id (IDENTITY), String title, String slug (unique), String description, String content (columnDefinition TEXT), String coverImageUrl, String coverImageObjectKey, Integer readingTimeMinutes, Boolean published (default false), Long authorUserId, String authorName, String category, LocalDateTime createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt; with @PrePersist/@PreUpdate setting timestamps

ArticleRepository.java extends JpaRepository<Article,Long> with: Optional<Article> findBySlug(String); boolean existsBySlug(String); Page<Article> findByPublishedTrue(Pageable); List<Article> findByPublishedTrueOrderByPublishedAtDesc(); List<Article> findByAuthorUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long); a @Query search method over title/description/content for published=true

dto/ArticleRequest.java (@Data, jakarta validation: @NotBlank title, @NotBlank content), dto/ArticleResponse.java and dto/ArticleSummaryResponse.java (@Data @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor) match the apiContract shapes
dto/ArticleImageUploadResponse.java with url and objectKey fields exists

mapper/ArticleMapper.java is a @Mapper(componentModel=spring) with toEntity(request) (ignoring id,slug,readingTimeMinutes,published,authorUserId,authorName,coverImageObjectKey,timestamps), toResponse(article), toSummary(article)

Flyway migration backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V14__add_articles.sql creates articles table (BIGSERIAL pk, slug UNIQUE NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, etc.) with indexes on slug, published, author_user_id, and creates landing_page_featured_articles (landing_page_id BIGINT, article_id BIGINT, position INT) table
Backend compiles: cd backend && JAVA_HOME=~/.jdks/jdk-21.0.11+10 ./mvnw -q -DskipTests compile succeeds

stories.title: Backend: ArticleService (slug gen, reading time, CRUD, publish, owner-scope, search, cover upload)
acceptanceCriteria: ArticleService.java @Service @RequiredArgsConstructor with constructor-injected ArticleRepository, ArticleMapper, S3Client, StorageProperties

createArticle(ArticleRequest, User): generates a unique unicode-aware slug from title, computes readingTimeMinutes=max(1,ceil(len(content)/1000.0)), sets authorUserId=currentUser.id and authorName from instructor first+last name (fallback email), sets published from request, sets publishedAt when published, saves and returns ArticleResponse

updateArticle(id, ArticleRequest, User): enforces owner-scope for INSTRUCTOR (BusinessException FORBIDDEN if not owner), regenerates slug only if title changed (keeping uniqueness), recomputes readingTime, updates publishedAt transition, returns ArticleResponse
getBySlug(slug): returns published article as ArticleResponse or throws BusinessException(ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND/NOT_FOUND) if missing or not published
getByIdForEdit(id, User): owner or ADMIN only; returns ArticleResponse including drafts
listPublished(Pageable): Page<ArticleSummaryResponse> newest first; searchPublished(query): List<ArticleSummaryResponse>; listMine(User): own (or all for ADMIN) as List<ArticleResponse>
setPublished(id, boolean, User): owner/admin toggles published + publishedAt
deleteArticle(id, User): owner/admin deletes

uploadCoverImage(MultipartFile): validates type (jpeg/png/webp) and size (<=5MB), puts to S3 under articles/covers/{uuid}-{name}, returns ArticleImageUploadResponse(url,objectKey); mirrors CourseService.uploadThumbnail
A new ErrorCode for article-not-found is added to common/exception/ErrorCode.java (e.g. ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND) OR an existing suitable 404 code is reused consistently
Backend compiles with JAVA_HOME=~/.jdks/jdk-21.0.11+10 ./mvnw -q -DskipTests compile

stories.title: Backend: ArticleController endpoints + SecurityConfig public access
acceptanceCriteria: ArticleController.java @RestController @RequestMapping(/api/articles) implements all endpoints from apiContract with correct verbs/paths

Public endpoints (GET list, GET search, GET /{slug}) have NO @PreAuthorize; write endpoints (POST, PUT, PATCH publish, DELETE, POST cover-image) and GET /mine, GET /id/{id} use @PreAuthorize("hasRole('INSTRUCTOR') or hasRole('ADMIN')") and obtain the user via currentUserService.getCurrentUser(authentication)
Literal routes /api/articles/search, /api/articles/mine, /api/articles/id/{id} are declared so they do not collide with /api/articles/{slug}
SecurityConfig.java permitAll list includes "/api/articles" and "/api/articles/**"
Backend compiles with JAVA_HOME=~/.jdks/jdk-21.0.11+10 ./mvnw -q -DskipTests compile

acceptanceCriteria: LandingPageConfig.java gains featuredArticleIds @ElementCollection (table landing_page_featured_articles, @OrderColumn position, column article_id) defaulting to empty list
dto/LandingArticleDto.java exists (id,title,slug,description,coverImageUrl,readingTimeMinutes,authorName,category,publishedAt)
LandingPageResponse gains List<LandingArticleDto> featuredArticles; LandingPageUpdateRequest gains List<Long> featuredArticleIds

LandingPageService injects ArticleRepository, hydrateArticles(ids) returns only published articles in selected order, getPublic() populates featuredArticles, update() replaces featuredArticleIds like featuredCourseIds

acceptanceCriteria: ArticleServiceTest.java at backend/src/test/java/com/itqan/edu/features/articles/ uses @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) with @Mock repo/mapper and @InjectMocks service
